ITEM 1 | Pale-to-deep yellow scrambled mass with soft, curdled, crumbly texture, moist-looking with slight sheen, pieces about 1-3 cm, irregular clumps, covering the upper center and right of the plate, piled up to roughly 2 cm high, sitting on top of the greens | 150
ITEM 2 | Mixed loose salad greens with frilly, ruffled light and dark green leaves and some reddish-purple edged leaves, matte and dry, spread across the lower half of the plate, leaves about 3-8 cm long, low flat layer about 1 cm thick | 40
